description: This file defines an Angular service (ApiService) that interacts with a backend API for project planning. It includes methods for fetching, saving, exporting plans, and retrieving resources, along with error handling and URL construction.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: Angular service for API interactions related to project planning.

methods.name: getPlan
methods.description: Fetches the current project plan from the backend.

methods.name: savePlan
methods.description: Saves the provided project plan payload to the backend.

methods.name: exportPlan
methods.description: Exports the project plan in specified format (pdf, docx, json).

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Retrieves available resources from the backend.
